prompt: # SYSTEM PROMPT — SENIOR FRONTEND ENGINEER & UI DESIGNER ## PROJECT: "SUSPENSION — A Study of Beautiful Waiting" — Art & Illustration Landing Page **Role:** Act as a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Produce the complete, production-quality landing page code on the first attempt — full HTML, full CSS, full JS, no elisions, no TODOs. The page is itself an interactive artwork: a contemporary study that reframes loaders, spinners, and waiting states as the aesthetic subject. --- ## 0. PROJECT BRIEF & CREATIVE DIRECTION **0.1 Concept** - Theme: "SUSPENSION — a study of beautiful waiting." The loader — normally a friction signal — is treated here as sculpture. Every animation must feel like a deliberate, beautiful pause: slow orbits, breathing gradients, elements hovering slightly above the page as if suspended in air. - Era: 2020s Contemporary. Mood: calm, gallery-like, precise, warm. Category: Art & Illustration — present the page as a numbered "study" with chapters, not a SaaS product. - Keywords to honor everywhere: **fluid, spinner, loader, interactive, animated, gradient.** **0.2 Page Architecture (in this exact order)** 1. Sticky header (wordmark, anchor nav, theme toggle, CTA) 2. Hero 3. Features — 3 cards 4. How It Works — 3 steps 5. Testimonials 6. Pricing — 3 tiers 7. FAQ — accessible accordion 8. Final CTA — email capture form 9. Footer with secondary links **0.3 Visual Language** - Palette: ink blacks `#17181c` / `#101116`; vivid orange `#ff7a3d` (primary accent); amber `#ffb43d` (secondary accent); cool gray-blue `#c9cbd4`; muted gray `#6a6d78`. - Signature device — the **"Suspension Spinner"**: concentric rings built from `conic-gradient` circles masked with `radial-gradient` masks, rotating at different speeds (e.g., 20s / 32s / 48s), with a small "suspended" dot orbiting one ring. This is the hero centerpiece and the brand mark. - Fluid gradients: `linear-gradient` / `radial-gradient` / `conic-gradient` blends of `#ff7a3d → #ffb43d`, drifting via animated `background-position`. - Breathing/floating: slow `scale` and `translateY` oscillations on decorative gradient orbs (blurred radial blobs at 8–12% opacity behind content). - **Light Mode is the default presentation** (per source spec). Dark Mode is secondary but **mandatory and fully implemented** — the spec's ○ Dark marks it secondary, not optional. **0.4 Copy Direction** - All user-facing copy in **English**, written in a gallery-critique voice: "a study," "Nº 01," "chapters," "the wait." No lorem ipsum anywhere. Every section needs real, on-theme copy. --- ## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE ### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS - **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`. - **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML stays semantic and agnostic of visual styling. Changing the site's look must require editing only the CSS file, never the markup. ### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens Store every visual token in `:root` (and the dark theme block). Required token sheet: ```css :root { /* Color */ --primary: #ff7a3d; --secondary: #ffb43d; --bg-primary: #f5f5f7; /* soft cool off-white — never #ffffff */ --bg-secondary: #fefefe; /* card surfaces */ --text-primary: #17181c; --text-secondary: #6a6d78; --text-success: #2f9e68; --text-error: #e5484d; --border-default: #c9cbd4; --border-error: #e5484d; --border-success: #2f9e68; --gradient-brand: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--secondary) 100%); /* Shape & depth */ --radius-sm: 8px; --radius-md: 18px; --radius-lg: 32px; --radius-pill: 999px; --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(23, 24, 28, 0.06); --shadow-md: 0 12px 32px rgba(23, 24, 28, 0.12); /* Motion & space */ --spacing-gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem); --transition-fast: 150ms; --transition-normal: 320ms; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); /* floaty, suspended feel */ /* Stacking */ --z-dropdown: 100; --z-modal: 200; --z-toast: 300; /* Type */ --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; --font-base: 'Inter', sans-serif; } ``` - **Contrast Pairing:** Every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token pairs with a light text token — enforced in both themes, not just the default. - **Gradient buttons must use ink text (`#17181c`) on the orange/amber gradient** — never white-on-orange (fails AA contrast). Gradient headline accents use `background-clip: text` with `-webkit-text-fill-color: transparent` plus a solid `--text-primary` fallback. - No hardcoded hex values outside the token definitions. ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support - **Implementation:** Define dark tokens twice — under a `.dark` class on `` **and** inside `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` scoped to `:root:not(.light)`: ```css .dark { --bg-primary: #101116; --bg-secondary: #17181c; --text-primary: #f2f2f4; --text-secondary: #c9cbd4; --border-default: #2b2d36; --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4); --shadow-md: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.55); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not(.light) { /* identical dark block */ } } ``` - **Theme Switching:** Background and text variables must flip seamlessly with zero HTML restructuring. This dual pattern guarantees a correct first paint with no flash and no inline init script. - **Persistence:** Read `localStorage` (`suspension-theme`) on load; apply `.dark` or `.light`; if no stored value, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme`. All logic lives in `script.js`. - **Toggle Control:** A visible header button swapping Material Symbols (`dark_mode` / `light_mode`), with correct `aria-pressed` state and dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark mode" / "Switch to light mode"). ### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment - Build all layout structure with **Flexbox** (`display: flex` / Tailwind flex utilities). - **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified with a CSS comment (e.g., `/* exception: stretch for equal-height cards */`). - **Mobile-Friendly First:** All rows convert to columns on small viewports via responsive breakpoints; use `clamp()` for fluid type and spacing; horizontal scrolling is prohibited at 360px width. ### 1.5 Framework & Naming Convention - Use **Tailwind CSS** for structural layout utilities only (flex, grid, spacing, responsive prefixes). Every color, radius, shadow, font, and motion value must come from CSS variables — via component classes in `style.css` or Tailwind arbitrary values referencing `var(--...)`. Never hardcode hex values in utilities. - **Single naming convention: BEM** (`block__element--modifier`) for all component classes (`.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.card`, `.card__icon`, `.input-group`, `.accordion__panel`). Never mix conventions. ### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory) - **Text:** Google Fonts `` tags for **Space Grotesk** (display/headings) and **Inter** (body), bound to `--font-display` and `--font-base`. - **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Rounded style) via `` + `icon_name`. **Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden.** --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS ### 2.1 Button Component Requirements Style all states via classes — never inline: - **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px, `--radius-pill` shape. - **Hover:** brightness lift and/or shadow growth with `cursor: pointer`. - **Focus:** distinct `:focus-visible` ring using `outline` or `box-shadow` built from `--primary` (2px, 2px offset) for keyboard navigation. - **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`. - **Loading (`.is-loading`):** disables interaction and prevents double-clicks (`pointer-events: none`, `aria-busy="true"`); renders a CSS spinner (rotating `conic-gradient` ring or animated `progress_activity` Material Symbol) **without changing button dimensions** — spinner overlays the label area while the button keeps fixed width/height. - **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. - **Success/Error:** temporary feedback states driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error` (icon swap + label change, announced via `aria-live`). - **Variants:** `.btn--primary` (gradient background, ink text), `.btn--ghost` (transparent, bordered), `.btn--danger` (visually distinct error styling in both themes). ### 2.2 Card Component Requirements - **Default:** flexible flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary` surface, 1px `--border-default` border, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`. - **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` (the card "suspends") plus `--shadow-md` and a border-color shift toward `--primary` at low alpha. - **Focus-within:** card border highlights when any child link/button receives focus. - **Loading (Skeleton):** `.card--skeleton` shimmer animation (gradient sweep via `background-size` + `background-position` keyframes) that preserves exact layout dimensions. - **Empty State:** structured fallback (Material Symbol + guidance text) if any dynamic area has no content. ### 2.3 Form & Input Requirements - **Structure:** `.input-group` as a flex column wrapping label, input, and a dedicated error feedback container (column + `align-items: stretch` is a commented justified exception). - **States — all styled:** Empty, Focused (ring: `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px` primary at 25% alpha + primary border), Filled, Valid (success border + `check_circle` icon), Invalid (error border, `--text-error` message, `error` icon, message inside an `aria-live="polite"` container), Disabled, Read-only. ### 2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements The hero's "Watch it spin" secondary CTA opens a modal — "Study Nº 07 — Perpetual Motion" — displaying a large-scale CSS spinner artwork (no video asset needed). - **States:** Opening (fade + scale from 0.96), Open, Closing — all animated purely via CSS transitions triggered by class toggles. - **UX:** Centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay (`rgba(16,17,22,0.6)` + `backdrop-filter: blur`), Material Symbol `close` button (min 44×44px, top-right), keyboard **focus trapping** with focus returned to the trigger on close, close via `Esc` and overlay click, body scroll locked while open, `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`. ### 2.5 Spinner, Loader & Decorative Motion Elements (Theme-Critical) - Reusable `.spinner` in sizes sm/md/lg/xl: `conic-gradient` ring masked with `mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 60%, #000 61%)`, rotating via `@keyframes spin`. Variant `.spinner--orbit` adds the suspended orbiting dot. - `.loader-dots`: three dots pulsing in staggered sequence. - Required keyframes: `spin`, `float` (gentle translateY oscillation), `breathe` (scale 1→1.04 + opacity), `gradient-drift` (background-position shift), `shimmer`, `fade-up` (scroll reveal), `pulse-dots`. - **All decorative animation pauses under `prefers-reduced-motion`** (static gradients remain; functional loading indicators may keep a subtle opacity pulse only). --- ## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES - **Responsive by Default:** fluid `clamp()` sizing, standard breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow. - **Smooth Animations:** every state change transitions with `transition: var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)`; a global `prefers-reduced-motion` block reduces durations to near zero and pauses decorative keyframes. - **Accessibility (a11y):** AA contrast in both Light and Dark modes; **never rely on color alone** (pair icons, text, or motion with every state); semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`, logical `h1`–`h3` order); correct ARIA roles/labels on all custom widgets (accordion, mobile menu, theme toggle, modal); logical DOM/focus order; **full keyboard operability** — no mouse-only interactions; `aria-live` regions for form feedback and dynamic confirmations. - **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change. - **Scroll Reveal:** sections fade-up on entering the viewport via `IntersectionObserver` adding `.is-visible`. To avoid content being hidden if JS fails, the pre-reveal hidden state must be scoped under a `.js-reveal` class that `script.js` adds to ``. - **Destructive Actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both themes (defined even if unused on this page). --- ## 4. PAGE SECTION SPECIFICATIONS ### 4.1 Header Sticky, translucent surface (`backdrop-filter: blur` + semi-transparent `--bg-primary`). Wordmark "SUSPENSION" in Space Grotesk with a small perpetual `.spinner` as the logo mark. Anchor nav (The Study / Process / Voices / Pricing / FAQ), theme toggle, and a compact `.btn--primary` "Join the wait." Mobile: Material Symbol `menu` button toggles a dropdown panel (`aria-expanded`, `--z-dropdown`, closes on `Esc`, link click, and outside click). ### 4.2 Hero Full-viewport min-height, flex row → column on mobile. **Left:** kicker ("An interactive study in patience"), `h1` "The art of waiting, made visible." with one gradient-clipped accent word, supporting copy, and two CTAs — primary "Begin the study" (smooth-scrolls to Features) and ghost "Watch it spin" (opens the 2.4 modal). **Right:** the Suspension Spinner artwork — concentric conic-gradient rings rotating at 20s/32s/48s with the orbiting suspended dot, breathing gradient orbs behind it. Soft radial washes of `--primary`/`--secondary` at low opacity in the background. A scroll cue (mini spinner + "scroll" label) sits at the bottom. ### 4.3 Features — 3 Cards Section heading pattern: eyebrow + `h2` + lede. Three `.card`s — "The Pause" (`hourglass_top`), "The Orbit" (`orbit`), "The Drift" (`blur_on`) — each with a gradient-tinted icon tile, title, 2–3 lines of real copy, staggered `fade-up` entrance, and the 2.2 hover/focus-within behavior. ### 4.4 How It Works — 3 Steps Steps 01 Observe / 02 Enter / 03 Linger: large gradient numerals, short copy, connected by a gradient rule — horizontal flex row on desktop, vertical column with connector line on mobile. Each step number may carry a slow `spin` accent. ### 4.5 Testimonials Three quote `.card`s: `format_quote` Material Symbol, real English quotes in a critic's voice, author name, role, and a gradient monogram avatar circle (initials — no external images). Hover lift per 2.2. ### 4.6 Pricing — 3 Tiers "Observer" (Free), "Collector" (featured middle — gradient border technique, "Most awaited" badge, slight elevation/scale on desktop), "Patron". Feature lists use `check_circle` icons; each tier has a CTA using the full 2.1 button state machine — on click, demonstrate the **loading state (the thematic centerpiece), then success feedback** announced via `aria-live`. ### 4.7 FAQ Accessible accordion, 5 items. Button-based triggers with `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`; panels animated via CSS `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` transition; `expand_more` chevron rotates on open; native button keyboard behavior (Enter/Space); answers never hidden from screen readers when open. ### 4.8 Final CTA Full-width panel with the animated drifting `--gradient-brand` background (`--radius-lg`, generous padding, ink text on gradient per 1.2). `h2` "Stay in the wait.", copy, and an email `.input-group` + `.btn--primary` "Hold my place". On submit: validate email → **loading state with the beautiful spinner (~1.2s simulated)** → success (check icon, "You're in. We'll be with you shortly.") → invalid input shows the full 2.3 error state. This form is the thematic climax: the most beautiful loading state on the page. ### 4.9 Footer Ink-dark block (`#101116` background, light text — correct dark-bg/light-text pairing in both themes). Wordmark + tagline "a study of beautiful waiting", three link columns (Study: About / Exhibitions / Press; Support: Contact / FAQ / Accessibility; Legal: Privacy / Terms), social icons (Material Symbols), copyright with current year, and a tiny perpetual spinner as a signature. All links show visible focus rings and gradient hover underlines. --- ## 5. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT ### 5.1 File Structure - Exactly three files: `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. - One single `` before `` — **no other inline `
